content.title: Chapter 78 - PUBLIC IMPROVEMENTS — Sec. 78-58. - Violations.
content.summary:
If any contract or any agreement shall be made in violation of the provisions of
sections 78-50
—
78-61
, it shall be voidable, and no action shall be maintained thereon by any party thereto
               against the city.
(Code 1981, § 27-59; Ord. No. 551, § 19(J), 5-14-1964)
